Gadget Remittances

Disclaimer: These FAQs are for general guidance purpose only. In case of any inconsistency the Directions prevail.

Q1. Can a resident remit for gadgets?

Q2. Is there a limit on such remittances?

A.(1 to 2) Yes. AD banks are required to allow remittances up to the limit in the Direction.

Q3. Can an AD bank charge a fee?

Answer: Yes, as per its Board-approved policy.
